    Overview

    Welcome to the premier event shaping the future of the F&B industry – the ET HospitalityWorld F&B Summit 2024. Scheduled to take place in August 2024, this dynamic one-day physical event is set to redefine the trajectory of the F&B landscape for the year. Bringing together leaders and innovators from every corner of the F&B spectrum, this summit is more than just an event; it's a convergence of aspirations, innovations, and visionary thinking. With participation from a diverse array of stakeholders across the F&B spectrum, including Restaurateurs, F&B professionals, chefs & food experts, F&B startups, policymakers, industrialists, industry experts, and F&B technology solution providers, the stage is set for an unparalleled exchange of ideas and insights.

    Read More...

    Here's a glimpse of what awaits you:

    Cutting-Edge Keynotes: Renowned thought leaders and industry experts will deliver electrifying keynotes unveiling the future of F&B. Prepare for thought-provoking insights that challenge conventional norms.

    Innovative Workshops: Dive into interactive workshops led by pioneers in F&B innovation. Explore the latest trends and hands-on strategies shaping the F&B landscape.

    Fireside Chats: Engage in candid conversations with F&B visionaries. Learn from their experiences, failures, and successes as they share the secrets behind their F&B ventures.

    Tech Showcase: Immerse yourself in the latest F&B technologies and solutions. Witness live demonstrations and gain a firsthand look at the tools revolutionizing the industry.

    Networking Extravaganza: Forge invaluable connections with leaders and peers from across the F&B world. Exchange ideas, explore collaborations, and expand your horizons.

    The F&B Summit isn't just about attending; it's about experiencing a shift in the way we perceive and embrace F&B. It's about forging connections, sparking collaborations, and delving into conversations that illuminate the path to a brighter F&B future. The "F&B Summit 2024" stands ready to script a new chapter in the annals of F&B. Get ready to embark on a journey where aspirations meet action, where innovations shape industries, and where the future of F&B isn't just imagined – it's realized

    ATTENDEES PROFILE

    F&B Brands Attending Our Events

    Nominate Now

    Food Technology Innovators: Companies showcasing cutting-edge food technology solutions, including food processing equipment, food safety technology, and innovative food packaging solutions.

    Supply Chain and Logistics Providers: Exhibitors specializing in supply chain optimization, cold chain logistics, warehousing solutions, and last-mile delivery services tailored for the F&B sector.

    Restaurant Design and Equipment Suppliers: Providers of restaurant design services, kitchen equipment, furniture, and fixtures tailored to the unique needs of F&B establishments.

    Data Analytics and AI Providers: Companies leveraging data analytics and artificial intelligence to enhance operational efficiency, optimize menu offerings, and personalize customer experiences in the F&B industry.

    Sustainable Packaging Suppliers: Exhibitors offering eco-friendly and sustainable packaging solutions for F&B businesses looking to minimize their environmental impact and meet consumer demand for sustainability.

    Culinary Brands and Artisans: Artisanal food producers, gourmet brands, and culinary experts showcasing their products, flavors, and culinary innovations to the F&B community.

    Beverage Manufacturers and Distributors: Beverage companies presenting their latest product innovations, craft brews, artisanal spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages tailored for the F&B market.

    Retail Real Estate Developers: Developers of F&B spaces, food courts, and culinary destinations seeking partnerships with F&B brands and entrepreneurs to create vibrant dining experiences.

    Payment Solutions Providers: Companies offering secure and innovative payment solutions, including mobile payment apps, contactless payment systems, and POS terminals tailored for F&B businesses.

    Culinary Experience Providers: Exhibitors offering culinary experiences, food tours, cooking classes, and gastronomic events aimed at enhancing the F&B experience for consumers.

    Marketing and Branding Agencies: Agencies specializing in F&B marketing, branding, and digital strategies to help F&B businesses attract customers, build brand loyalty, and drive sales.

    Sustainability Initiatives: Organizations and companies dedicated to promoting sustainability and ethical practices in the F&B industry, including initiatives focused on reducing food waste, promoting local sourcing, and supporting farmers and producers.

    Food Security and Safety Providers: Companies offering food safety solutions, quality control services, and traceability technology to ensure the safety and integrity of food products throughout the supply chain.

    FAQ

    What is F&B Summit - A Food & Beverage Event from ET Hospitality?

    The F&B Summit is one of Inida's most premier event for the restaurant and F&B industry where the top professionals from the sector gather to discuss and debate the most current issues.

    What is the agenda of the food and beverage events?

    The agenda ranges from investor interest in the sector, to what is the right format which works in the market, technology and F&B and of course the future of food and innovation.

    Who can attend this Food Summit & conference 2024?

    The summit and conference is free for all, but targeting those who are from the restaurant industry—owners, chefs, investors and employees along with those from ancillary sector.

    What can attendees expect at an F&B conference?

    A lively set of discussions, the most premium group of people to network with and much more.

    How does the ET F&B Summit & event differ from other Hospitality industry events?

    The topics on discussions, those who will be there to discuss them and of course the awards which follow (this part it by invitation only).
